name: פודיום: כסף, זהב, ארד
src: l=>{ const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>b-a); return s.length<2?s:[s[1],s[0],...s.slice(2,3)]; }
note: Podium layout: second place, then first, then third (fewer when the list is short).

name: קיצוץ העגלה לתקציב 40
src: l=>{ const r=[...l]; while(r.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)>40){ r.splice(r.indexOf(Math.max(...r)),1); } return r; }
note: Over budget: repeatedly removes the most expensive item until the cart total is at most 40, keeping the remaining items in order.
how: מצב-רחב-2: קיצוץ: כל עוד Σx > 40 — הוצא את מקסימום נייד

name: פריט אחד מכל קטגוריה
src: l=>{ const seen=new Set(); return l.filter(x=>{ const c=x%4; if(seen.has(c)) return false; seen.add(c); return true; }); }
note: Keeps only the first item of each category (category = value mod 4), preserving order.

name: העמוד האחרון
src: l=>l.length?l.slice(Math.floor((l.length-1)/3)*3):[]
note: Pagination with 3 items per page: returns the items on the last page (1 to 3 items), empty for an empty list.

name: היפוך שלושת הראשונים
src: l=>[...l.slice(0,3).reverse(),...l.slice(3)]
note: Reverses only the first three elements and keeps the rest in place.

name: מחיקת הפריט השלישי
src: l=>l.filter((x,i)=>i!==2)
note: Deletes the item at index 2 (third position) if it exists.

name: ביטול ההוספה האחרונה
src: l=>l.slice(0,-1)
note: Undo: drops the most recently added (last) item.

name: סבב בטורניר
src: l=>{ const r=[]; for(let i=0;i<l.length;i+=2) r.push(i+1<l.length?Math.max(l[i],l[i+1]):l[i]); return r; }
note: Knockout round: the larger of each adjacent pair advances, and an unpaired last element advances automatically.
how: זוגות [הוצא ראשון: קטן מ- · הוצא שני: לא קטן מ-]

name: זוג לכרטיס מתנה 23
src: l=>{ for(let j=1;j<l.length;j++) for(let i=0;i<j;i++) if(l[i]+l[j]===23) return [l[i],l[j]]; return []; }
note: Finds the first pair (by position of its second item) whose sum is exactly 23 and returns it in list order; [] if none.

name: קצץ את הצד הכבד
src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return []; const s=l.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0), t=2*s>23*l.length?Math.max(...l):Math.min(...l); return l.filter(x=>x!==t); }
note: If/else on the average (sum vs 11.5 times the length): when the average is above 11.5 it drops the maximum, otherwise it drops the minimum.
how: מצב-רחב-2: אם Σ(2·x) > 23·n ⇒ מקסימום נייד, אחרת מינימום — הוצא אותו

name: מעל החציון
src: l=>{ const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>a-b), n=s.length; if(!n) return []; const m=n%2?s[(n-1)/2]:(s[n/2-1]+s[n/2])/2; return l.filter(x=>x>m); }
note: Statistic filter: keeps the elements strictly above the median (mean of the two middle values for even length), in original order.

name: בלי הגבוה והנמוך
src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return []; const M=Math.max(...l), m=Math.min(...l); return l.filter(x=>x!==M&&x!==m); }
note: Judges' trimmed scores: removes both the maximum and the minimum, keeping the rest in order (lists of length 2 or less become empty).

name: בין הראשון לאחרון
src: l=>{ if(l.length<2) return []; const a=Math.min(l[0],l[l.length-1]), b=Math.max(l[0],l[l.length-1]); return l.filter(x=>x>a&&x<b); }
note: Range filter from the list's own endpoints: keeps elements whose value lies strictly between the first and last values, whichever is larger.

name: זוגיות מתחלפת
src: l=>{ const r=[]; for(const x of l){ if(r.length&&x%2===r[r.length-1]%2) break; r.push(x); } return r; }
note: Take-while on a neighbor relation: keeps the leading run whose parity alternates, stopping at the first element with the same parity as the one before it.
how: קח-כל-עוד [חתוך כש[צירוף: מינימום(זוגי?(חיבור מספרים(x, עזר)), תנאי: 8,9,10,11,12,13(וגם (מספרים)(x, עזר)))] · עזר=הקודם]

name: קרובים לממוצע
src: l=>{ const n=l.length, s=l.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0); return l.filter(x=>Math.abs(2*n*x-2*s)<=3*n); }
note: Outlier removal against a statistic: keeps the elements within 1.5 of the list average (computed exactly from the sum), in original order.

name: שיאים מקומיים
note: Two-sided neighbor filter: keeps each element larger than both its neighbors (an end element only needs to beat its single neighbor).
how: סנן [שלישיית-ערכים #77824b0f0b18 = לא (מספר)(שווה (מספרים)(תא0, הגדול מבין שלושה(תא0, תא1, תא3)))(x, הבא, הקודם)]

name: אריזה לתיק עד 40
src: l=>{ let s=0; const r=[]; for(const x of l){ if(s+x<=40){ s+=x; r.push(x); } } return r; }
note: Greedy packing with skipping: goes in order and adds each item that still fits a capacity of 40, skipping (not stopping at) items that do not fit.
how: מצב-רחב: תקציב 40 · g=x · דלג על מה שלא נכנס

name: מהשיא עד השפל
src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return []; const i=l.indexOf(Math.max(...l)), j=l.indexOf(Math.min(...l)); return l.slice(Math.min(i,j),Math.max(i,j)+1); }
note: Positional slice chosen by statistics: keeps the contiguous stretch between the positions of the maximum and the minimum, both included.

name: החצי הכבד
src: l=>{ const h=Math.floor(l.length/2), A=l.slice(0,h), B=l.slice(l.length-h), S=a=>a.reduce((p,q)=>p+q,0); return S(A)>=S(B)?A:B; }
note: Decision between two halves: compares the sums of the first and last floor(n/2) elements (the middle one is ignored) and keeps the heavier half, the first half on a tie.
how: מצב-רחב-2: שני-חלקים: A=Σx(ראשונים ⌊n/2⌋) B=Σx(אחרי ⌈n/2⌉) ⇒ A≥B ? A : B

name: מגמת הפתיחה
src: l=>{ if(l.length<2) return [...l]; const up=l[1]>l[0], r=[l[0],l[1]]; for(let i=2;i<l.length;i++){ if(up?l[i]>l[i-1]:l[i]<l[i-1]) r.push(l[i]); else break; } return r; }
note: Direction decided by the data: the first step sets rising or falling, then keeps the longest prefix that continues in that same direction.
how: דקדוק: l.cat(l.takeWhile(l.id, (prv < x)), l.slice(l.id, 1, agg.first(d.runlens(l.id, (b < a)))))

name: רצף איכות בממוצע 12
src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return []; let s=l[0]; const r=[l[0]]; for(let i=1;i<l.length;i++){ if(s+l[i]<12*(r.length+1)) break; s+=l[i]; r.push(l[i]); } return r; }
note: Take-while on a running statistic: always keeps the first element, then extends the prefix while the average of the kept elements stays at least 12 (running sum vs 12 times the count).
how: מצב-רחב-2: ממוצע-רץ של x ≥ 12 · הראשון חופשי · קח-כל-עוד

name: החצי הראשון
src: l=>l.slice(0,Math.ceil(l.length/2))
note: Keeps the first half of the list, with the middle element included when the length is odd.

name: המקסימום לראש
src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return []; const m=Math.max(...l); return [m,...l.filter(x=>x!==m)]; }
note: Pin-to-top: moves the largest element to the front and keeps the others in their original order.

name: החלפת הקצוות
src: l=>l.length<2?[...l]:[l[l.length-1],...l.slice(1,-1),l[0]]
note: Swaps the first and last elements while the middle stays in place.

name: החלפת זוגות סמוכים
src: l=>{ const r=[...l]; for(let i=0;i+1<r.length;i+=2){ const t=r[i]; r[i]=r[i+1]; r[i+1]=t; } return r; }
note: Pairwise swap: exchanges positions 0/1, 2/3, 4/5, ...; a trailing odd element stays put.

name: היפוך כל חצי
src: l=>{ const h=Math.floor(l.length/2); return [...l.slice(0,h).reverse(),...l.slice(h).reverse()]; }
note: Splits at floor(n/2) and reverses each half separately (the longer half is the second one).

name: אי-זוגיים ואז זוגיים, ממוינים
src: l=>[...l.filter(x=>x%2===1).sort((a,b)=>a-b),...l.filter(x=>x%2===0).sort((a,b)=>a-b)]
note: Partition by parity with odds first, each group sorted ascending (house numbers: odd side, then even side).

name: הקרוב ל-12 קודם
src: l=>[...l].sort((a,b)=>(Math.abs(a-12)-Math.abs(b-12))||(a-b))
note: Nearest-to-target ordering: sorts by distance from 12, ties broken by the smaller value first.

name: שזירת חצאים
src: l=>{ const h=Math.ceil(l.length/2), a=l.slice(0,h), b=l.slice(h), r=[]; for(let i=0;i<h;i++){ r.push(a[i]); if(i<b.length) r.push(b[i]); } return r; }
note: Perfect riffle shuffle: splits at ceil(n/2) and alternates first-half and second-half elements.

name: מיון יציב לפי שארית 3
note: Stable sort by the derived key x%3: groups 0,1,2 in order, equal keys keep their original relative order.

name: מיון לפי XOR 5
note: Sorts by the bitwise key x XOR 5, giving the fixed order 13,12,15,14,9,8,11,10.

name: מיון יורד, הגדול לסוף
src: l=>{ const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>b-a); return s.length?[...s.slice(1),s[0]]:[]; }
note: Two steps: sorts descending, then rotates left by one so the maximum ends up last.

name: מיון הזוגיים במקומם
src: l=>{ const e=l.filter(x=>x%2===0).sort((a,b)=>a-b); let k=0; return l.map(x=>x%2===0?e[k++]:x); }
note: In-place partial sort: the even elements are sorted ascending among the even slots while odd elements keep their positions.
